# Profile

## Biomedical & Electrical Engineering

I have interdisciplinary training in **Biomedical Engineering and Electrical Engineering**, with experience
across biomedical research, electronics, embedded systems, medical devices, robotics, medical imaging,
FPGA, CAD and experimental system integration.

My engineering approach is strongly implementation-oriented: define the physiological or technical need,
translate it into measurable requirements, build the system, calibrate it, test it and iterate from data.

:::: {.home-metric-grid}

::: {.home-metric}
**Biomedical R&D**

Instrumentation, perfusion, preservation, neuroengineering and experimental validation.
:::

::: {.home-metric}
**Electronics & Embedded**

PCB, ESP32, STM32, sensors, acquisition, communications and system integration.
:::

::: {.home-metric}
**Engineering Prototyping**

CAD, mechanical integration, 3D printing, machining and iterative testing.
:::

::::

# Current Research

## Ex Vivo Liver Viability & ICG-NIR

My Master's research focuses on the development of an **ex vivo liver perfusion platform** and the use of
**indocyanine green fluorescence in the near infrared (ICG-NIR)** to investigate quantitative indicators
of liver function and viability.

The research progresses through three connected objectives:

:::: {.home-step-grid}

::: {.home-step}
::: {.step-number}
01
:::
**Perfusion Platform**

Stable circulation, physiological control and instrumentation.

[Open Objective 1](projects/thesis.qmd#objective-1--ex-vivo-perfusion-platform){.inline-project-link}
:::

::: {.home-step}
::: {.step-number}
02
:::
**Physiological Baseline**

Pressure, flow, temperature, vascular resistance, pH and gases.

[Open Objective 2](projects/thesis.qmd#objective-2--baseline-dataset-without-icg){.inline-project-link}
:::

::: {.home-step}
::: {.step-number}
03
:::
**ICG-NIR Marker**

Fluorescence kinetics and quantitative functional parameters.

[Open Objective 3](projects/thesis.qmd#objective-3--icg-nir-functional-marker){.inline-project-link}
:::

# Selected Work

## CYBATHLON 2024 — Ciervo UC

I participated in **CYBATHLON 2024 in Zürich** as Electrical Area Leader of Ciervo UC, working on the
electrical and electromechanical integration of a robotic transfemoral prosthesis.

[Open project →](projects/cybathlon.qmd){.inline-project-link}

## CandelStim — Neuroengineering

During my professional internship at Candel Medical Company I worked on electronics and firmware for a
transcranial electrical stimulation platform, including circuit analysis, PCB work, embedded systems,
communications, signal generation and validation.

[Open project →](projects/candel.qmd){.inline-project-link}

# Engineering Areas

## Biomedical Instrumentation

Physiological sensing, pressure, flow, temperature, perfusion systems, calibration, acquisition and
experimental validation.

## Electronics & Embedded Systems

Analog and digital electronics, PCB, microcontrollers, ESP32, STM32, Arduino, communications and
hardware/software integration.

## Medical Imaging, Signals & Optics

Signal and image processing, deep learning, biomedical optics, NIR fluorescence and experimental data analysis.

## CAD, Prototyping & Integration

Fusion 360, mechanical design, 3D printing, machining and integration of electronics, fluidics and mechanics.
